q: For a self-adjoint (Hermitian) linear operator T on a finite-dimensional inner product space, the spectral theorem guarantees:
opts: T is diagonalizable with real eigenvalues and orthonormal eigenvectors
exp: The spectral theorem for Hermitian operators: all eigenvalues are real and eigenvectors for distinct eigenvalues are orthogonal, giving an orthonormal eigenbasis that diagonalizes T.
